title: A spectacular visit
text: ! Manuel was an excellent guide: friendly, approachable, and very knowledgeable about history. He made discovering the Alhambra a very pleasant, interesting, and unforgettable experience. Highly recommended! Thank you, Manuel, for your professionalism and enthusiasm. A 10! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

title: Good professional
text: We did a guided tour of Salobreña and a panoramic tour of Motril with Manuel and it went very well. He explains things very well, is kind, and is a good professional. A good day. I recommend it....

title: Great professional and very approachable.
text: Manuel guided us on a visit to the Salobreña castle and the old town. Great professional, very kind, very knowledgeable, and very patient in answering all the questions... the visit was very worthwhile, I recommend it without a doubt.

title: Visit to Salobreña Castle
text: I love Manuel's way of guiding and sharing. He is a person passionate about his work, who not only gives explanations of the Salobreña Castle (or any place he takes you to visit)... but who proposes a true experience full of surprises and curiosities. Thanks for everything Manuel!

title: Totally recommended
text: The visit was great, we went with the children and they were immersed in the stories and legends the whole time. It was a great success to end the month of August like this. Highly recommended for all the data it offers, and it demonstrates great knowledge of the subject. See you on another outing.
